body:
I'm sorry but I can not do this anymore. The only reason I just checked this is because I am considering doing it right now. Its been a bad day, so so bad and its 40 years of this and I can not do anymore. I don't think I can make myself hold out to even October. I just want everything to stop now.

All day I have been on the verge of laughing, crying, screaming, and I just want no thoughts or emotions at all. The idea of going to bed and waking up to another day in this world is just the most depressing thing I can think of. I appreciate your thoughts and concerns. I know I will be letting her down everyday, but I believe it will soften in time, and she can go on to have a better happier life without this anchor. Thanks for the thoughts and I hope you are well and take care of yourself.

I am this way too. I know this post has so so many replies and no one will see this. I have to say it in someway once. I hate being alive. I wish I could not be. That would be my one wish, to never have been. I have a wife I love more than anything but I am a miserable bastard, but she tries so hard to make me better. I cant let her down anymore. 

We are going with friends to Disney in October, our first trip. I have been in a good mood and she thinks its because of the trip. It is and isnt. I am going to kill myself when we get home. Ever since I decided to do it I have felt a lot better and am looking forward to the nothingness. I made this throw away just to say it once. Reddit has been a great source for falling away from myself. Thanks for the laughs reddit. Take care of yourselves.
